# Lantern on a post: the glass is emissive (unlit splats). Up Z.
new
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 0.5
scale 0.08 0.08 1.0
apply --scale
material new Wood --base-color 0.392 0.325 0.333
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0.14 0 0.95
scale 0.28 0.06 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Lamp --size 1 --location 0.26 0 0.78
scale 0.16 0.16 0.2
apply --scale
material new Light --base-color 0.867 0.812 0.600 --emission 0.867 0.812 0.600
select all
shade flat
export lantern.glb
